base_dir.description: The base directory where the images are located.

image1.description: The filename of the first image to compare.

image2.description: The filename of the second image to compare.

fov.description: Field of view in degrees. Range: [0.1, 89.9].

threshold.description: Number of pixels p below which differences are ignored.

gamma.description: Value to convert rgb into linear space.

luminance_only.description: Only consider luminance; ignore chroma (color) in the comparison.

color_factor.description: How much of color to use. Range: [0.0, 1.0].

down_sample.description: How many powers of two to down sample the image.

scale_images.description: Scale images to match each other's dimensions.

sum_errors.description: Print a sum of the luminance and color differences.

output_file.description: Write difference to the file o.
